label: Object Detection
description: Detect objects (tree crowns, vehicles, people, ...) on a task's orthophoto with an ONNX detector — a YOLO export or a torchvision/DeepForest export — and return their bounding boxes as GeoJSON with class and confidence. Detectors are model cards in models/: add a card and its weights, rebuild the package and upload it to bring your own model.

model.title: Model
model.description: Detector to run (a model card in models/). deepforest-tree-crowns: DeepForest — tree crowns (airborne RGB); visdrone-yolov11s: VisDrone — vehicles & people (YOLO11s, aerial). Parameters left at 0/-1 use the card's recommended values.

confidence.title: Confidence threshold
confidence.description: Minimum class confidence to keep a detection; 0 uses the model's recommended value.

iou.title: NMS IoU threshold
iou.description: Boxes of the same class overlapping more than this (intersection over union) are merged across tiles; 0 uses the model's recommended value.

tile_size.title: Tile size (px)
tile_size.description: Tile edge in orthophoto pixels; each tile is resized to the model input. 0 uses the model's recommended size (its native input when the card sets none). Ignored when a ground tile size is set.

overlap.title: Tile overlap (px)
overlap.description: Overlap between neighbouring tiles so objects on a tile edge are seen whole by one of them; at least the largest object. -1 uses the model's recommended value.

tile_size_m.title: Tile size (m, ground)
tile_size_m.description: Tile edge in ground metres, derived into pixels from the orthophoto's resolution so objects appear at the same scale on every dataset. 0 uses the model's recommended value, if any, else the pixel tile size.

overlap_m.title: Tile overlap (m, ground)
overlap_m.description: Overlap in ground metres; -1 uses the model's recommended value, if any, else the pixel overlap.

max_detections.title: Maximum detections
max_detections.description: Keep at most this many boxes (the most confident); protects the map from a runaway model.

class_filter.title: Class filter
class_filter.description: Comma-separated class names to keep (see the model's classes). Empty keeps all.
